question: Should `runIsolatedCompletion` become the supported optional agent-harness capability for external plugin runtimes, or should this remain a bundled-only/private runtime seam until its compatibility contract is separately approved?
rationale: The PR adds documentation for harness implementers and a new callable runtime capability; repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive and requires maintainer-visible direction.

options.title: Approve the harness contract
options.body: Treat isolated completion as a supported optional harness capability and merge after the stacked auth prerequisite and owner validation are complete.

options.title: Keep it bundled-only for now
options.body: Move the capability behind an internal bundled-runtime seam and defer external plugin documentation until maintainers approve a stable SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the harness contract
recommendation.body: Treat isolated completion as a supported optional harness capability and merge after the stacked auth prerequisite and owner validation are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current stacked implementation and can clarify the intended external versus bundled contract boundary.
